title: The Chaldean Oracles, Vol. 2
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: The second volume of G. R. S. Mead's presentation of the Chaldean Oracles. It continues the exploration of fragmentary teachings that shaped later Neoplatonic accounts of divine reality, sacred practice and spiritual ascent.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/the-chaldean-oracles-vol.-2-echoes-from-the-gnosis-volume-ix).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
